title: xi dats UI action
description: A client table with some entries changed: a d_msg string table (strings), an item table (items) or a zone's dialog table (dialog). The build reads the table as the target sees it, applies the edits in resources.json, and writes the result at the same ROM path — a retail file, so no file id is registered. Everything the edits do not name is carried over byte for byte. The texture / layout / spells categories are reserved and not built yet.

dat.description: The table's ROM path. One language's DAT per action: a JP table is a second action.

entry.description: strings: the sub-string index the edits set when an edit gives no "sub" of its own (default: the block's first text sub-string).

json.description: The edits: the JSON the matching export command writes (xi ui strings export, xi ui items <group> json, xi event dialogue export), or an object holding that list under "edits".

grow.description: An edit whose id is past the end of the table grows it (empty entries up to the id, then the entry). Off: such an edit fails the build.

grown_to.description: The table's entry count after growth, or null when it did not grow.

created.description: True when the target held no copy of the table before this build, so undo deletes the one it wrote; false when the build edited a copy already there (the install's own file, or an earlier build's), which undo leaves.
